name: Motif
description: personal color palette by and for me. single source of truth for the palette and semantics shared by ports.

semantics.textMuted: secondary text, placeholders, timestamps (verified against every surface a target ships)
semantics.primary: brand accent: links, primary buttons, focus

accessibility.rule: Every text/background pair a target ships must meet normalText; UI borders and non-text indicators must meet largeTextAndUI.

website.mechanism: SCSS mixins (@include motif.light / motif.dark) mapped to the site's --color-* custom properties; the partial is fetched as a Lume remote file pinned to a commit on git.celikci.me
website.note: Consumes this repo; no longer the origin of the palette.

forgejo.mechanism: CSS override fragments for :root, appended to Forgejo's stock theme at build time; only the variables Motif changes are named, so everything else keeps tracking Forgejo upstream
forgejo.note: Two fragments, one per scheme; Forgejo picks one by which file is applied, not by a selector inside it. The ANSI and named-color variables (--color-ansi-*, --color-blue, ...) are deliberately inherited, not overridden. Consumer side not recorded here yet.

navidrome.mechanism: MUI theme objects (MotifLight / MotifDark) replacing ui/src/themes/light.js and dark.js at build time; useCurrentTheme hands those two modules to the UI's Auto setting, so both schemes must be provided
navidrome.note: Navidrome cannot load external theme files, so the build has to be patched. palette.type is required because useCurrentTheme reads it for the body background. Consumer side not recorded here yet.
